## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up two the shoe model with ribbed sole, tips left, into the orange box for keeping shoes.

Task description: Put the two brown lace-up shoe models on the left and right sides of the table into the orange shoebox in front, with both toes facing left.

Success criteria: From the main view, place the shoe originally on the left in the nearer middle area inside the box and the shoe originally on the right in the farther middle area. Both must lie flat with toes pointing left, uppers up, soles down and near the box bottom. Both grippers must be open and release the shoes.

## Execution tips

- Grip continuous middle shoe sides near the sole across its width, avoiding laces, opening and narrow toe. Ensure full pad contact to reduce slipping or rotation during lifting.
- The gripper opening can be slightly wider than the shoe at the chosen section. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the shoe body, rather than pressing only on the upper or resting on the sole edge.
- The left shoe's toe already points approximately left; preserve this usable orientation. When turning the right shoe, lift its sole off the table and leave rotation clearance for both toe and heel to reduce sweeping into the box rim or bottle behind.
- When placing items inside the box, stagger when the two grippers enter the opening and leave clearance for the fingers, box walls, and other shoe. Avoid having the shoe inside while the fingers are stuck on the rim.
- Before releasing, let the shoe sole rest on the bottom of the box. As the gripper withdraws, watch the shoe opening and laces to avoid catching them and changing the placement.
